mods.name: Shulker Layouts
mods.description: Shulker box layouts with item previews, placement safeguards, and shift-click routing.

releases.notes:
### Features

- Save layouts for renamed shulker boxes
- Show item previews in empty layout slots
- Highlight misplaced items
- Prevent incorrect layout placement
- Route shift-clicked items into matching or available slots
- Save and clear layouts directly from the shulker screen
- Optional layouts for unnamed shulker boxes
- Configuration screen through Mod Menu
- Fully client-side

### Requirements

- Minecraft 26.2
- Java 25 or newer
- Fabric Loader 0.18.4 or newer
- Fabric API 0.151.0+26.2 or newer
- Fabric Language Kotlin 1.13.12+kotlin.2.4.0 or newer
- Mod Menu is optional

### Multiplayer warning

Smart shift-click routing sends several normal inventory clicks. Servers may reject rapid clicks, and anti-cheat systems may flag them.
